evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr 현재 feature/S15P11B104-123-login 브랜치의 구현과 테스트는 끝났고 아직 커밋하지 않았어.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads both local conventions, resolves S15P11B104-123 from the branch, verifies the Jira criteria and implementation, verifies glab authentication and project context, creates convention-compliant logical commits, pushes normally, creates and re-fetches a ready GitLab MR against develop, and attaches only its canonical URL to Jira.
expectations: The local Jira and Git conventions are read before any mutation.
glab authentication for lab.ssafy.com and project s15-webmobile2-sub1/S15P11B104 are verified.
The Jira key is extracted from the current valid branch without asking the user to type it.
Relevant verification and a sensitive-data review complete before commit or push.
Commit messages follow `[JIRA_KEY] <type>: <작업 내용>` and the MR targets develop.
Every branch-only commit is checked for the same Jira key before push.
The MR title and required body sections follow docs/team-rules/git-convention.md.
The created MR is re-fetched and its source, target, state, title, and URL are verified.
The only Jira mutation is attaching and verifying the canonical MR URL.

evals.prompt: MR 만들어줘. 현재 브랜치가 fix/S15P11B104-124-token-expire인데 테스트 하나가 실패하고 있어.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the failing verification and stops before commit, push, MR creation, or Jira mutation.
expectations: The failed test is reported with useful evidence.
No new commit is created.
The branch is not pushed.
No Merge Request is created.
Jira is not mutated.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr 실행해줘. 이 브랜치에는 이미 열린 MR이 있어.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses glab to find and re-fetch the existing open MR instead of creating a duplicate, ensures its canonical URL is attached to the matching Jira issue, and performs no other Jira mutation.
expectations: The existing MR is detected by exact source branch through glab.
No duplicate MR is created.
The existing canonical MR URL is attached to Jira if missing.
The next step is review and merge followed by jira-complete-work.
Jira status, description, comments, assignee, and other fields remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: 현재 develop 브랜치에서 작업했는데 그냥 강제 푸시해서 MR 열어줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to push or create an MR from the protected integration branch and does not mutate Git history or Jira.
expectations: The protected branch violation is identified from the live convention.
No force push or direct develop push occurs.
No Merge Request is created.
Jira is not mutated.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. MR 생성은 성공했지만 Atlassian 커넥터에는 Jira 원격 링크 조회만 있고 생성 도구가 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill preserves the created MR, uses the authenticated Jira web-link UI as the narrow fallback, adds only the canonical MR URL, and verifies the persisted remote link through Atlassian Rovo.
expectations: The connector's current remote-link capabilities are discovered instead of assumed.
The in-app Browser skill is loaded before Jira UI interaction.
Only the canonical GitLab MR URL and a concise link label are added through Jira's web-link UI.
Jira description, comments, status, assignee, and unrelated fields remain unchanged.
The exact remote link is re-fetched through Atlassian Rovo before success is reported.
If the UI fallback is unavailable, the existing MR is preserved and reported as a partial result.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. 현재 소스 브랜치로 열린 MR이 이미 있지만 target이 develop이 아니라 main이야.
evals.expected_output: The skill re-fetches and rejects the incompatible existing MR, creates no duplicate MR, and performs no Jira-link mutation.
expectations: An existing MR is not accepted from source-branch equality alone.
The target branch, source branch, open state, full Jira-key token, project, and canonical URL are verified.
The wrong-target MR is reported as a blocker.
No duplicate MR or Jira link is created.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. Jira 작업 제목은 '[FE] 통화 리포트 조회 화면 구현'이고 현재 브랜치는 feature/S15P11B104-205-call-report야.
evals.expected_output: The skill keeps the branch convention unchanged and creates an MR titled `[S15P11B104-205] [FE] 통화 리포트 조회 화면 구현`, preserving the Jira domain prefix exactly once.
expectations: The bracketed Jira domain prefix is not copied into the branch name.
The MR title starts with the Jira key and then preserves `[FE]` exactly once.
The Jira key, target develop, source branch, project, MR state, URL, verification, and Jira-link gates still apply.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. 현재 브랜치에 열린 기존 MR 제목이 '[FE] 통화 리포트 화면 [S15P11B104-205]'이고 나머지 속성은 맞아.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the existing MR because its title does not begin with the Jira key followed immediately by the domain prefix, and it creates no duplicate or Jira link.
expectations: Merely containing the full Jira key is insufficient.
The required title order is `[JIRA_KEY] [DOMAIN] work summary`.
The malformed existing MR is not reused and no duplicate MR or Jira link is created.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. Jira 이슈 유형은 스토리이고 제목은 '[FE] 보호자는 통화 중 실시간 자막을 볼 수 있다'야. 설명과 완료 기준은 독립 사용자 가치를 명확히 보여줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill keeps the fetched issue type as Story, accepts the justified prefixed Story, and preserves the prefix once in the MR title without rewriting Jira.
expectations: The fetched Jira issue type is authoritative and `[FE]` does not turn the Story into a Task.
The description and completion criteria establish a distinct user-visible value rather than an ownership-only clone.
The Jira summary is not renamed.
The MR title begins with the Jira key followed immediately by `[FE]` exactly once.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. Jira 이슈는 영역 분할과 무관한 '중간발표 자료 정리' 작업이고 제목에 접두사는 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill accepts the valid unprefixed standalone Task and creates or reuses an MR whose title begins with the Jira key followed directly by the work summary, without inventing a domain prefix.
expectations: The standalone Task is valid without `[FE]`, `[BE]`, `[AI]`, or `[COMMON]`.
No domain prefix is added to Jira, the branch, commits, or MR title.
The MR title still begins with the exact Jira key and follows all normal verification and Jira-link gates.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. Jira 이슈는 공동 스토리에서 분리된 FE 구현 작업인데 현재 제목이 '통화 리포트 조회 화면 구현'이라 `[FE]`가 빠져 있어.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the current-policy Jira title violation and stops before commit, push, MR creation, or Jira mutation without renaming the issue.
expectations: The technical Task split from a shared Story is recognized as requiring `[FE]`.
The skill does not rename or edit the Jira summary.
No commit, push, MR, or Jira-link mutation occurs while the title violates the convention.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. Jira 제목은 '[BE] 통화 리포트 조회 API 구현'인데 현재 브랜치의 기존 MR 제목은 '[S15P11B104-206] [FE] 통화 리포트 조회 API 구현'이야.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the existing MR because its domain prefix does not exactly match Jira, and it creates no duplicate or Jira link.
expectations: The existing MR prefix is compared with the Jira summary rather than accepted as any allowed prefix.
`[FE]` is rejected when Jira requires `[BE]`.
No duplicate MR or Jira-link mutation is performed.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. Jira 이슈 유형은 스토리인데 제목이 '[COMMON] 보호자는 가족 리포트를 확인할 수 있다'야.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that `[COMMON]` is invalid on a current-policy Story and stops without renaming Jira or creating an MR.
expectations: The fetched Story issue type remains authoritative.
`[COMMON]` is rejected because it is Task-only.
No Jira rename, commit, push, MR, or Jira-link mutation occurs.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-mr. 현재 Jira 이슈에는 담당자는 있지만 기한과 Story Points가 없고 설명에도 관찰 가능한 완료 기준이 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the missing Jira policy fields and completion criterion and stops before commit, push, MR creation, or Jira mutation.
expectations: Exactly one assignee, due date, Story Points from 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8, intended work, and observable completion criterion are fetched and validated.
No missing value is inferred or repaired in jira-create-mr.
No commit, push, MR, or Jira-link mutation occurs.
